text.text: Use a filled supported bucket, Copper Can or lantern on an empty Duct to insert one filter item. Use an empty hand to retrieve it. Both Seared and Scorched Ducts work this way.

A Faucet drains only controller fluid matching the filter, including its NBT. An empty filter drains nothing. Retrieve the filter before breaking, replacing or moving the Duct. Unknown saved data is protected rather than discarded.
This draft requires the matching guard-capable host and PlutoLib. The original filter menu and fluid model are not yet supplied. Live play, save/reload and LAN remain unverified.
